key_findings: Crotalphine partially reversed EAE-induced mechanical hyperalgesia and reduced clinical severity, even when given after motor onset.
Crotalphine reduced spinal infiltrate, glial activation, TNF-alpha and IL-17 and preserved sciatic nerve myelin thickness; NGF reduction was unchanged.
